# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [OpenAI starts text watermarking, with detector access limited to researchers](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-06/01-openai-text-watermarks.html) — API watermarking is opt-in, while the EU rollout for ChatGPT and Codex is planned over the coming weeks.
- [Moving a flowchart onto a slide without losing its logic](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-06/02-editable-flowchart-relayout.html) — A new preprint proposes three stages and editable XML instead of a single regenerated image.
- [Pale rocks beyond Jezero may offer clues to the depths of Mars](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-06/03-perseverance-light-rocks.html) — Perseverance is examining possible breccia, while the origin of scattered boulders remains a hypothesis.
- [Samon turns patterns in sand into a puzzle with checkable answers](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-06/04-samon-raking-puzzle.html) — The browser prototype offers 148 gardens, an explicit turn score and hints about the player’s own route.
- [Curiosity drills its 48th rock target — the minerals still have a story to tell](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/01-curiosity-basque-lakes.html) — The team is examining the Basque Lakes sample in the new Cache Creek area, separating successful drilling from analysis still to come.
- [Before returning to the Moon, NASA is listing what it still does not know](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/02-lunar-data-gaps.html) — Engineer Richard Spolzino explains how missing information becomes measurable targets for instruments and partners.
- [Webb reads the history of collisions in dust around young stars](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/03-webb-collision-dust.html) — The composition of 21 unusual disks helps distinguish possible impact scenarios; the telescope did not film collisions as they happened.
- [An overspending email or a stop: cloud limits join the conversation about agents](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/04-cloud-spending-caps.html) — Simon Willison argues for hard limits by default; AWS and Google already offer mechanisms with different scopes and conditions.
- [Showing a local site over SSH: two familiar tools instead of another client](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/05-http-over-ssh.html) — Vincent Bernat describes a self-hosted OpenSSH and nginx tunnel; the protocols explain where delivery ends and access control begins.
- [The agent said done — ThinkingBox checks the database](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/06-thinkingbox-state-checks.html) — An open benchmark separates valid tool calls from correct outcomes and repeatable execution.
- [OpenAI plans a visual ad test during image generation](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/07-chatgpt-visual-ads-test.html) — The US pilot is planned for October, alongside measurement tools that distinguish attributed sales from additional ones.
- [Niobium in Hubble's archive points to a possible second-generation planet](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/08-white-dwarf-planet-candidate.html) — Unusual material around a white dwarf offers a way to test planet formation after a star's main life.
- [AstaBrief opens a small model for cited scientific reports](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/09-astabrief-cited-reports.html) — Ai2 releases weights and training datasets, making report speed and evidence grounding easier to examine separately.
- [NASA refines measurements of clouds that can ice aircraft](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-05/10-nasa-large-droplet-icing.html) — New probes in an icing tunnel will help check large-droplet models, with test analysis still underway.
- [A furnace rehearsal for Venus — DAVINCI survives 465 °C](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-04/01-davinci-heat-test.html) — Engineers heated a development model six times on a descent-like schedule to check its protection for scientific instruments.
- [Crew-12's science wrap-up — what the crew studied aboard the ISS](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-04/02-crew-12-science.html) — NASA reviews the crew's research, from pharmaceutical crystals to metal printing in microgravity.
- [Morocco gets its first woman prime minister](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/01-morocco-first-woman-pm.html) — King Mohammed VI named Marrakesh's mayor as the country's first female prime minister.
- [Trump tells the US government to stop saying "artificial intelligence](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/02-trump-superintelligence-order.html) — A new executive order rebrands AI as "Super Intelligence" across federal messaging.
- [The ice blasting off Enceladus is stranger than scientists realized](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/03-enceladus-ice-chemistry.html) — Freezing ocean droplets may sort chemicals on their own before they shoot into space.
- [The UK is paying more on 10-year debt than at any point since 1999](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-30/04-uk-mortgages-bond-auction.html) — As gilt yields hit a 26-year high, UK mortgage approvals sank to their lowest since late 2023.
